tools.name: compare_ctp_prices
tools.description: Compare NSW green slip (CTP, compulsory third party insurance) prices of all six NSW insurers - the regulated prices from SIRA's price check, the same as the greenslips.com.au calculator. Use it when someone needs a green slip: registration (rego) renewal due, buying a vehicle or bringing one to NSW

tools.name: get_green_slip_result
tools.description: Open a saved NSW green slip price comparison from greenslips.com.au (or compare_ctp_prices) by its Greenslips reference - the 8-character code shown with a result and at the end of its link (calculator.html?load-result=...). Use it when someone gives a reference or a result link, to see those prices
